CustomField.label: Renewal Outlook
CustomField.description: Renewal outlook from the latest churn risk Fin flagged.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Churn_Risk__c, "High"), "At risk", IF(ISPICKVAL(Churn_Risk__c, "Medium"), "Watch", IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(Fin_Sentiment__c, "Slightly Negative"), ISPICKVAL(Fin_Sentiment__c, "Negative")), "Likely, watch value", "Likely")))
